name: Home Is Where He Is
source:
After your grandfather's death, you inherit an isolated and decaying residence, shrouded in silence. What should be a routine inventory turns into a surveillance nightmare when you realize your every move... is being watched.

Someone — or something — is watching you. Someone knows your habits, your clothes, and your secrets.

[From [url=https://echo0bat.itch.io/hiwhi]itch.io[/url]]
